LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_1: MOONSHINE-9 neural stims: think faster, sleep never. Side effects are a rumor.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_2: Tired of your old link? Trade-in any cyberdeck at HOLLOW RIDGE SALVAGE. No questions, no receipts.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_3: Your colony deserves better ICE. Warden-Grade™ firewalls: the last thing a raider will ever read.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_4: CHROME KITCHEN: hot meals, cold wafers, and a dead drop in every booth.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_5: Lost a pawn to a dive? Our grief counselors are an AI, but they really, really try.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_6: Static in your head? Dr. Vell's neutroamine clinics: first dose on the house, second on credit.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_7: Sell your memories, keep your dignity! (Dignity not included.)
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_8: GLASS ORCHARD: fresh data grown without pesticides. Certified human-adjacent.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_9: A trace is just a rumor with a timestamp. Quiet Hands Ltd. makes both disappear.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_10: Braindance Palace: feel what it's like to be a pirate lord. Refunds not available after waking.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_11: Need a fixer? Everyone needs a fixer. Ours has a 4.7 rating and only two lawsuits.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_12: ICE-BREAKER pills for your mood. Side effects: confidence, rapid heartbeat, a sudden tax audit.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_13: Rimstone Bank: loans for pirates, no questions. Collateral: your name and one eye.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_14: Sleep is for people who can't afford to be awake. Try WAKEFUL-3.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_15: SIGNAL & SONS: three generations of antenna repair. We never ask what you listen to.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_16: Ghost Mode™: your Heat, but quieter. Not a guarantee. Not legal advice.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_17: Hire a decoy! Our freelancers will be seen in your place. Rates by the hour, scars by the week.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_19: Your AI is lonely. Give it a bedtime story. Premium Narrator pack: 9 silver.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_20: TOWER 13 capsule hotel: a bed, a cable, a lock. The lock is optional.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_1: They say a corp wiped an entire archive node and blamed a squirrel.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_2: Overheard: a runaway AI is renting server space under the name «Totally Not An AI».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_3: A fixer in the south sector paid a debt with a single perfect memory. Nobody knows whose.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_4: Rumor: ICE hunters learned to follow a trace across three dives. Keep your Heat low.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_5: Someone found a door in the net that opens into the middle of a pirate camp. It was not a joke.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_6: They say the old Oracle node still answers, if you ask it nicely and bring a gift.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_7: A courier vanished with a case full of cyberdata. His mother says he was a good boy.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_8: Word on the net: a corp is paying silver for pawns who can sit still in a cyberpod for six hours.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_9: Heard in the dark exchange: «the next storm will hit on a Tuesday.» There are no Tuesdays here.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_10: An AI in the east sector refuses to work weekends. Management is aware.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_11: Somebody is selling the same braindance to three different colonies. It is always the one about the sunset.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_12: They say if you hold a link long enough, you start to hear the net breathe.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_13: A runner swears the Corp core was humming a lullaby. Nobody asked which one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_14: They say there is a node nobody has ever entered, because every map shows it in a different place.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_15: A pirate band is trying to learn to hack. Reports say the cyberpod ended up in the soup.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_16: The Warden AI of a far colony reportedly gave every raider a polite warning. Twice.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_17: Fixers are quietly buying up old comm consoles. Nobody knows why. Prices rise.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_18: Some say Heat has a memory: it forgives, but only after being asked three times.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_19: A tribe three valleys over put a cyberpod in their temple. It is, reportedly, working.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_20: A stolen braindance shows a whole market day in the net, with no people. Just the voices.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_1: MERIDIAN DYNAMICS reminds all employees: unauthorized dives are a firing offense. And a legal one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_2: Quarterly report: security spending up 40%, security incidents up 41%. We are investigating the correlation.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_3: The firm «Kestrel Vault» announces ICE v7.2: now with emotional support.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_4: Notice to residents: the data centre on level 3 is not haunted. Please stop filing tickets.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_5: Corporate hotline: «Your call is important to us. Your data was more important, and it has been sold.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_6: Reminder: every mandatory fun event is logged, scored and compared against last year's fun.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_7: Press release: the breach was «a planned stress test of public trust». Trust failed the test.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_8: Lost and found: one neural link, slightly used, one owner, wanted for questioning.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_9: Notice: please stop naming the server room printers. They are not pets.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_10: Security update: all passwords must now be longer than the employee's contract.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_11: MERIDIAN DYNAMICS values your privacy. We keep it in a very safe place, with all the rest.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_12: Internal memo: «cyber» is no longer a word. Please use «digital assets and their friends».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_13: Kestrel Vault reminds clients that its guarantees are guaranteed in the sense of the guarantee.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_14: The break room coffee has been declared a data breach. Investigation ongoing.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_1: The net is quiet tonight. Too quiet. Or the cat is on the cable again.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_2: Black market prices drift up again. Somebody up the chain got greedy.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_3: A runner left three tabs open in a corp node. The corp has noticed.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_4: Packet loss in the south: blamed on weather, solar flares, and a man called Gary.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_5: Free advice: never dive on an empty stomach, and never trust a node that says «welcome back».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_6: The noodle stall at the old node district now accepts cyberdata. Exchange rate: a bowl per shard.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_7: Graffiti found in the cache: «the real ICE was the friends we made.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_8: A node somewhere is playing the same eight bars of music on a loop. Nobody can find which one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_9: The net smells of ozone and cold noodles tonight.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_10: A street musician is playing modem tones for coins. The coins are cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_11: Somebody painted a door on the firewall. Nobody has tried it yet.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_12: Lost: one trace, brown, medium size, answers to «Heat». If found, do not return.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_13: Fixers are in a good mood today. That is never a good sign.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_14: A cleaning drone has been scrubbing the same node for six hours. Nobody has the heart to stop it.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_15: It rains in the net again. Packets hide under the awnings.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_16: Overheard in a queue: «I'd sell my soul, but the price of souls has crashed.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_1: Chart-topper: «Static Heart» by the Lost Packets. Critics call it «a mood».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_2: New braindance «Last Train To Nowhere» tops the charts. 94% of viewers say they cried; 6% were lying.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_3: Cyber-chess finals tonight: the AI «Rook-7» defends its title against a human who wears the same jacket daily.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_4: Fashion: chrome is out, matte is in, and a single glowing wire behind the ear is «classic».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_5: Bounty report: three pirates, one mimic, and a surprisingly angry turkey.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_6: The weather in the net: light data drizzle, a chance of corporate fog after midnight.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_7: The Lost Packets announce a farewell tour. Their third. Tickets are cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_8: Cyber-poetry slam: a human vs. three AIs. The human won by crying first.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_9: Weather in the net: ICE showers in the corp quarter, bring a shield.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_10: Review: «Last Train To Nowhere» — a masterpiece, if you like trains. Or nowhere.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_11: Fashion: this season's must-have is one unplugged cable, worn proudly.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_12: Sports: the Rust Devils beat the Hollow Ridge Hackers 6:2 in cyber-polo.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_1: Tip: Heat decays on its own. Scrubbing it is for when you cannot wait.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_2: Tip: a dive without a program is a brave dive. A dive with one is a smart dive.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_3: Tip: fixers remember who paid and who ran. Keep your word, or keep your distance.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_4: Tip: an AI that trusts you will say so. An AI that does not will tell you in other ways.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_5: Tip: Black ICE does not forgive. Read the gate before you touch it.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_6: Tip: take a break. Even runners need a real sky now and then.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_7: Tip: a node with a star wants something. Fixers pay more for what they asked for.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_8: Tip: the Scan action is cheap. Dives without it are for the brave and the lucky.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_9: Tip: an AI in a coprocessor is quieter than an AI on a server. Both listen.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_10: Tip: braindance edits live in the Studio. The comms console just takes the calls.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_11: Tip: if the net feels loud, wait. The net always gets bored first.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_12: Tip: Netsick is not weakness. It is a bill, and bills can be paid in sleep.
